content: You will earn the respect of all if you begin by earning the respect of yourself.
author: Musonius Rufus
sourceWork: Lectures and Sayings of Musonius Rufus
story:
At its core, this reflection cuts through our everyday excuses. Thinking about doing something gives us a comfortable dopamine hit of progress without any of the actual friction. We often use over-researching and planning as socially acceptable disguises for fear of starting.

In Musonius Rufus's view, genuine strength is not an abstract theory—it is a lived, daily practice. Clarity follows action; it does not precede it. You cannot think your way into a new way of living—you have to act your way into a new way of understanding. The smallest real-world step beats the most brilliant theory.
reflectionPrompt: In what area of your life are you overthinking the ideal approach instead of taking the simple, honorable action?
